title: SWF: Compile multi-scene documents
description: Verify that a FlashDocument with multiple scenes compiles all scenes into a single flat SWF timeline. Each scene's frames follow the previous scene's frames. FrameLabel and SceneAndFrameLabelData tags correctly reference scene boundaries. Tests: 2-scene doc with 3 frames each → SWF with 6 ShowFrame tags, correct scene labels at frames 0 and 3.
